head_custom_properties.neck_v3: Rest-space neck color and roughness masks; smootherstep transitions; local Taubin relaxation, unchanged topology and rig
head_custom_properties.refined4: Neck shortened 9 mm with smooth transition, neck contour relaxed; rest neck/head/eye bones and shader coordinates remapped
head_custom_properties.facial_controls: Object Data > Shape Keys: JawOpen, Smile.L, Smile.R. 0 = exact neutral. Conservative test ranges, not production certification.
head_custom_properties.blink_status: Existing full-closure blink keys and gaze are preserved; see prior face geometry QA limitations.
head_custom_properties.Face rig quality: Refined face retained: 72 shape keys and 50 drivers. No phoneme/lip-sync or automatic contact certification.
head_custom_properties.Eye rebuild: Welded continuous eyelid skin with fixed lower lid, true fitted globes behind immutable iris caps, and root-bound lash motion. Original body/rig/actions preserved. See eye rebuild report.
head_custom_properties.Lash refinement: Uniform dark brown lash pigment on existing true lash geometry. Source silhouette and root-bound corrective motion unchanged.
head_custom_properties.Face gaze notes: True rigid eye-volume/iris motion, ±6° yaw / ±4° pitch. Native Geometry Nodes smoothly ease source-fit posterior clearance up to 0.65 mm yaw plus 0.45 mm down gaze (1.10 mm combined). Exact neutral bypass and fixed socket/lower lid. Only simple built-in driver expressions are used; no script auto-execution required. Export requires baking or a dedicated export rig.
head_custom_properties.Face expression controls: BrowRaise.L/R, BrowKnit.L/R, CheekLift.L/R, LipPucker, MouthWide are conservative native surface deformations. CORR_Face_* are automatic cheek-volume correctives; do not animate directly.
head_custom_properties.Face r2: Three additive local shapes and bounded presets. Original shape keys and fixed lower eyelids preserved. Strength 0 returns exact neutral. No ARKit or phoneme mapping claimed.
head_custom_properties.Clean_Base_R3: Bikini geometry removed. New neutral 2K skin bake. Original rig, body proportions, face and current separate hair retained.
head_custom_properties.Clean_Base_R3_HoleRepair: Closed one pre-existing 4-edge underarm/torso slit with two faces; no vertices moved or added.
head_custom_properties.Assembly_Role: Original refined face; exact retained R3 geometry, UVs, shape keys and weights.
head_custom_properties.EyelidSurface_R3_Description: Harmonic upper-lid interior parameter spacing with smooth thin-plate depth reconstruction from surrounding skin and closure boundaries,8 held-blink samples,0.25mm globe clearance bound. head_custom_properties.EyelidPigment_R3_Description: Smooth clean-skin pigment from existing atlas interior, broad upper-lid region and softly feathered head-skin halo. Original images and UV unchanged. Neutral factor zero; brows, lower lids and identity retained.
head_custom_properties.LashRoot_R3_Description: Malformed medial fringe replaced by smooth continuous lid margin and tapered lashes, native9-sample rim following. Outer original lashes retained; all head keys and rig preserved.
head_custom_properties.R4_NeckAlignment: Neutral neck re-centered to face/rig x=.00195 with smooth local join reconstruction; no face geometry above z=.843 changed, expression deltas preserved.
